teams.note: The defending national champions won their third title, after 1980 and 2043, going 15-2 and beating Eona, Pistolheart, Skeenerland State and Tengus State 34-28 in the final at Kirkwood. Defensive coordinator Pascal Northbury left to become Ranroman's head coach and lineman Frode Althardt went first overall in the draft, but tailback Antonella Cisneros, cornerback Deja Maygate and safety Ernest Steinmeier return and five-star lineman Lourdes Buenalarga arrives. Voters gave them 57 of the 60 first-place ballots, and the repeat bid opens at home against UHMM.

teams.note: A 16-1 season, nine conference wins and a place in the final ended with a 34-28 loss to Costique River, and the school's only title is still 2026. Quarterback Beatrice Peatbourne, the Ryskamp winner, went in the first round, but Layla Smith is in year 18, Abena Upshaw has arrived from Pistolheart as defensive coordinator, and five-star quarterback Dahye Lurong is the new face. Defensive coordinator Rhys Fontenot left to run Cherry Lake, and the schedule opens at home against Grizzly Hills.

teams.note: Twenty-one national titles, more than any other team in the preseason top 25, and a 10-4 season that ended with a 20-17 round-two loss to Marblehead after a first-round bye. Offensive lineman Katarina Kleinhuber and cornerback Kirovei Eisemyr went in the first round, with lineman Rowena Rowridge, safety Adebayo Mensah and cornerback Harendra Gangakumar still on the roster and five-star receiver Sidney Langwell arriving. Perla Notaro is in year four with her whole staff intact, the opener is at Crayellan, and the season ends at Hatesei.

teams.note: Three titles, the last in 2042, and a 10-4 year that ended in round two against Costique River after a 41-7 win over Ediville State. Tyrell Kingsmond and Tavesei Roresei went in the first round, but cornerback Varun Chalhoub and tailbacks Verity Peatham and Fiona Peatshaw return, with five-star offensive lineman Torben Tannenbrunner joining them. teams.name: Rogaela State
teams.note: A 14-1 season with a perfect 9-0 in the conference, a round-two win over Yrei Trobniy and a quarterfinal loss to Marblehead at the Lumber Bowl. The staff under Rami Campbell, in year 19, is untouched and only two players were drafted, both in the fifth round; quarterback Spiros Kyriapoulos, lineman Konrad Kalthauer and tight end Louniya Tetreimyr return and five-star receiver Vladislav Dememelis arrives. The opener is at home against Krobe State and the season closes at home against Dietsche.

teams.name: Marblehead
teams.note: The run to the semifinals began with a win over Lito Rock State, then North Hatesei in round two and Rogaela State at the Lumber Bowl before a 38-7 loss to Tengus State at the Copper Bowl, a 12-5 year. Lineman Danica Vlahos went second overall and safety Maoxin Taoduo in the first round, and offensive coordinator Antoine Anysei left for Pistolheart. Onawa Khan is in year 17, linebacker Devonte Durmore and tight end Nils Weinbrandt return, five-star receiver Esi Amanse arrives, and the opener is at East Costique.
